CustomField.description: Counts the number of Deliverable Line Items marked as Delivered for this Deliverable. This represents how many individual units of the Deliverable have been completed by Operations.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. Each Deliverable Line Item represents one unit of work. This field shows how many units have been delivered so far and is used to track delivery progress and earned value visibility. Do not edit manually.
CustomField.label: Delivered Units
